categories.name: مُفْرَدَاتُ قِصَّةِ أَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ
categories.nameEn: Key Terms from the Story of the Elephant (Surah Al-Fil)

items.verseEn: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
And He sent against them birds in flocks,
Striking them with stones of hard clay,
And He made them like eaten straw.

categories.name: مُفْرَدَاتٌ مِنْ سِيَاقِ تَكْذِيبِ الْأُمَمِ لِلرُّسُلِ فِي سُورَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ
categories.nameEn: Key Terms from the Context of Denying the Messengers in Surah Al-An'am

items.verse: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
items.verseEn: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away therefrom.

items.verse: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
items.verseEn: For they had denied the truth when it came to them, but there is going to reach them the news of what they used to ridicule.

items.verse: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ مَّكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًۭا وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرَ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
items.verseEn: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them which We had established upon the earth as We have not established you? And We sent [rain from] the sky upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them; then We destroyed them for their sins and brought forth after them a generation of others.

items.verse: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
items.verseEn: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule.

categories.name: صِفَاتُ اللهِ فِي قِصَّةِ أَصْحَابِ الْأُخْدُودِ
categories.nameEn: Attributes of Allah in the Story of the People of the Ditch (Surah Al-Buruj)

items.verse: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
items.verseEn: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

items.verse: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
items.verseEn: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.
Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.

categories.name: صِفَاتُ الْقُرْآنِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Attributes of the Quran in the Quran

items.verse: يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُطْفِـُٔوا۟ نُورَ ٱللَّهِ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَيَأْبَى ٱللَّهُ إِلَّآ أَن يُتِمَّ نُورَهُۥ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
items.verseEn: They want to extinguish the light of Allāh with their mouths, but Allāh refuses except to perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it.

items.verse: هَـٰذَا بَصَـٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ
items.verseEn: This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].

items.verse: قَيِّمًۭا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا
items.verseEn: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward [i.e., Paradise].

items.verse: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
items.verseEn: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

harf.hint: The act of returning; Allah is fully capable of bringing humans back after death.
harf.verse: 86:8 - Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.

deduction.title: The Builders of the Lofty Pillars
deduction.intro: You stand before the ruins of a majestic ancient city, its lofty pillars now fallen. The wind howls through the empty streets, carrying the memory of a mighty people who once ruled these lands. Who were they?
clues: We were a people of immense strength and skill, known for our great buildings and advanced civilization.
We lived in a land of sand dunes and rocky hills, and we believed no one could overpower us.
A messenger came to us from among our own kin, calling us to worship Allah alone, but we rejected and ridiculed him.
We boasted, 'Who is stronger than us?' and we continued in our arrogance and idol worship.
Allah sent upon us a furious wind that blew for seven nights and eight days, laying waste to everything.
We were the people of 'Ad, the builders of Iram, and our fate became a warning for all who came after.

trial.label: What was the punishment sent upon them?

location.label: What is the name of their legendary city?

outcome.label: What was their ultimate fate?
options: They were destroyed and their remains became a lesson
They were drowned in the sea
They were buried under a landslide
outcome.answer: They were destroyed and their remains became a lesson

deduction.arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
deduction.verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)

translations: every soul what it has sent forth
scramble.hint: A powerful call to taqwa (God-consciousness), urging believers to reflect on their deeds before the Day of Judgment and remain mindful of Allah.
scramble.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍۢ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
scramble.verseEn: O you who have believed, fear Allāh. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Aware of what you do.
